page.overview:
Who is Tyreca Bremack?

Tyreca Bremack was a female senator in the Galactic Republic who represented the 245 systems of the Lahara sector, which seceded from the Republic and joined the Confederacy of Independent Systems prior to the start of the Clone Wars.
